description:
What a wallet holds in a store (owned items plus live unlocks), or — with sku — who owns a SKU. Pass exactly one of wallet or sku. Store key scope: entitlements:read.

Params: store_id, wallet?, sku?, cursor? (owners list only), session_token?
Returns: {storeId, wallet, entitlements: [{sku, type, name, quantity, expiresAt, source: 'ledger'|'unlock', firstGrantedAt}]} or {entries: [{wallet, quantity, expiresAt}], nextCursor}
Errors: INVALID_PARAMS, NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_get_entitlements
title: Get item holdings
